text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Basri submits draft law on regionalisation during cabinet meeting, saying it will meet expectations of Moroccan people.
- Prime Minister Filali proposes report on government policy on privatisation to be delivered in parliament on Tuesday.
- Mediterranean environment meeting closes with pledge to define priorities before looking for funds.
- Heavy rains expected in Morocco for weekend.
- Rainfall reveals appalling state of roads.
- Morocco and Cape Verde sign accord to strenghten cooperation.
- Moroccan Economic Observatory says Morocco is backward on human resources and technology.

- Appeal of people arrested during campaign against smuggling early this year could be dealt with more leniently after government signs agreement with Moroccan Business Confederation to appoint technical commissions to lead inspections in place of interministerial teams.
